CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA: feat(nock): multi-clip glTF import -- ImportGLTFBytesAllClips imports every real animation clip in a multi-clip file (e.g. Quaternius's Universal Animation Library), not just the first (a real, silent data-loss gap in the old single-clip importer). Each additional clip becomes its own animation-only row, attachable via the existing attach-animation flow (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
